question: Identify the top 10 and bottom 10 interest categories based on their highest composition values across all months. For each category, display the time(MM-YYYY), interest name, and the composition value
sql:
WITH max_composition AS (
    SELECT 
        im.interest_id,
        im.month_year,
        im.composition,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY im.interest_id ORDER BY im.composition DESC, im.month_year) as rn
    FROM interest_metrics im
    WHERE im.interest_id IS NOT NULL
),
top_bottom AS (
    SELECT 
        mc.interest_id,
        mc.month_year,
        mc.composition
    FROM max_composition mc
    WHERE mc.rn = 1
),
top10 AS (
    SELECT 
        tb.month_year AS time,
        im.interest_name,
        tb.composition
    FROM top_bottom tb
    JOIN interest_map im ON tb.interest_id = im.id
    ORDER BY tb.composition DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
bottom10 AS (
    SELECT 
        tb.month_year AS time,
        im.interest_name,
        tb.composition
    FROM top_bottom tb
    JOIN interest_map im ON tb.interest_id = im.id
    ORDER BY tb.composition ASC
    LIMIT 10
)
SELECT time, interest_name, composition FROM top10
UNION ALL
SELECT time, interest_name, composition FROM bottom10
ORDER BY composition DESC
